simulation validation counted Adjacent via RViz/CARLA, but RViz is visualization and CARLA was training-data generation, not sim-gating of robot skills before hardware

screening_gaps: No behavior tree, state machine or task planner used to script robot behaviors at skill level; this is the core of the Skills team job
No test infrastructure: no automated regression tests, TDD, or CI, and no practice of turning logged failures into repeatable tests
No production or customer-site deployment experience and no mobile manipulation, against a 2+ year ask
llm_analysis.reasoning: The hardware and manipulation half of the role is well backed: real arms, MoveIt/kinematics, and documented failure root-causing. The scripting-framework half (behavior trees, task planners, skill API) and the test-infrastructure half (regression, TDD, CI) have no direct backing. Reachable at the I level if the hardware debugging story leads, but expect a screen on behavior-tree and testing depth.
